title: scenarios: travel_expense pins its dataset names, so a build cannot collide with the ambiguous word the card measures
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic); the maintainer set who files this epic's cards, verbatim: 「你应该负责立卡，对方只是派发处理」. The gap was reported by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6951773597), from area o3-F's five-repetition ask round on #34687; the filer did not re-read the records behind it.

## Why

The card asks an ambiguous word on purpose. A build that names its own dataset with that word changes what the word matches, so the question no longer measures what it was written to measure.

## Evidence

- Per the report: a build added its own `travel_spend` dataset, which collides with the ambiguous `dq_travel_spend` word of the card.

## Scope

- The card states the dataset names a build must use (under `expect.datasets`), or the ambiguous word is chosen so no natural dataset name equals it.
- File surface: `docs/qa/scenarios/travel_expense.json`.

## Done when

- Two builds of the card give the ambiguous question the same set of matches.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34687 (PR #34808).
